commit.message:
Updated variants

set R292-R297 as DNP

v1.2 ready for review

Added ESP board connector

- Updated USB connector, closes #27
- Fixed #26
- Replaced oscillator with ECS-3953M-1000-BN, closes #29, closes #28
- Added BP I2C header #42

v1.1rc2

- Removed MGT net labels, added N/C markers, closes #24
- Added legend to J13, closes #22
- Added esd diode to clock input, closes #23
- Added 3 GND THT testpoints, closes #21
- Added IC designators to PCB
- Fixed variants #10
- Updated outputjob file

v1.1rc1

- Added PE_CLK diff pair class and length matching rules
- Swapped clocks on fanout to reduce length difference
- Added xsignals and loose length matching rules
- Tigthened manufacturing rules
- Added fiducial targets
- Changed CPU JTAG connector to one with key
- Added missing ESD strips
- Updated layer stack table
- Added ESD protection to goldpin connectors - closes #20
- Added license to the PCB - closes #13
- Added copper balancing - closes #14
Changed STM32 JTAG connector to have a keyed shroud

PCB routed (there are still DRC errors, but pinout should be final).

- Updated PCB stackup to one from Kasli (6 layers)
- Fixed polarity of 3_PE_CLK
- Updated impedance profiles
- Rerouted most of the PCB
- Fixed #17
- Fixed #3
- Fixed #5
- Fixed #9
- Fixed #12
- Changed IC1 to 24AA025E48T-I/OT, fixes #18

- Added no erc to ignore multiple net names on SE signals to LVDS transceivers (not possible to fix due to multichannel design)
- swapped LVDS transceivers' MISO signals
- changed project settings to suppress warnings about i/o pins connected to input, output pins, ports and sheet entries
- added pin swapping to the FPGA

- Moved differential signals to bank 2
- Distributed single ended signals bo banks 0, 1, 8
- Changed VCCIO of bank 2 to P2V5 from P3V3
- Changed signal assignment according to #3

WIP fixing schematics

- Fixed #2
- Fixed #4
- Added P3V3 in schematics (#5)
- Removed double pullups for I2C1, 10k pullups remain - fixes #6
- Added voltage translator for LM75 and power supply I2C lines - fixes #7
- Fixed #15
- Added P12V0 molex connector, fixes #8
- DNPed CPU_RESETn pullup to P3V3_MP, fixes #11
- updated no-erc on VOUT of IC13 to remove errors with output-output and output-power pin type connection
- updated license to OHL v2.0-W
- updated schematic template
- moved some parameters from sheet level to project level where it made sense:
  - project/equipment name
  - title - project name
  - address
  - contact
  - version
  - total sheet number
  - source location
- added no erc on n/c signals
